title: Manufacturing Engineering Supervisor
description:
Job Description:

The Manufacturing Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading all Engineering teams within the plant, ensuring flawless and successful product launches and robust high-volume production processes. This role provides both functional and disciplinary leadership to manufacturing engineers and process technicians, guaranteeing performance, quality, and continuous improvement across all manufacturing activities..

Key Responsibilities:

Leadership & Management

  • Provide functional and disciplinary leadership to the Manufacturing Engineering teams.
  • Oversee process technicians, ensuring alignment with plant goals and operational excellence.
  • Lead decision-making, strategic planning, resource allocation, and budgeting activities.
  • Monitor and control KPIs, define objectives, and ensure effective performance management and staff development.
  • Prepare and deliver regular reports to the Plant Manager.

Manufacturing Engineering

  • Lead Mechanical Engineering teams on all topics required to ensure program success from launch to mass production.
  • Ensure that robust, efficient, and safe production processes are implemented and sustained on the shop floor.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives following Mechanical Engineering standards, Lean methods, and EBOS principles.
  • Monitor process performance and ensure processes consistently deliver the expected results.

Engineering Change & Transfers

  • Own and manage local Engineering Change Management for product and process modifications, ensuring minimal impact on mass production lines.
  • Lead and oversee production transfers to and from the plant, ensuring seamless execution.

Quality & Customer Requirements

  • Ensure all customer requirements are met, including corrective and preventive actions.
  • Support product design and development activities to ensure compliance with manufacturing standards and process capabilities.

Requirements:

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or related fields.
  • Post-graduate degree or MBA in engineering, manufacturing, management, or related areas.

Experience & Technical Skills

  • Strong experience in manufacturing engineering within an industrial environment.
  • Advanced knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement, and mechanical engineering applications in production.
  • Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience with engineering change management (product and process).
  • Solid understanding of performance indicators, strategic planning, and budget management.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Inspirational, results-driven leadership.
  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication skills across all organizational levels.
  • Proactive, organized, and with a strong systems-thinking mindset.

title: Estagiário em Remuneração e Budget
description:
CONHEÇA UM POUCO SOBRE O GROUPE SEB:

Facilitar o dia a dia das pessoas, tornando o cotidiano mais agradável ao redor do mundo. É com esse foco que nós do Groupe SEB transformamos há mais de 160 anos as necessidades de nossos consumidores em soluções úteis e inovadoras.

Somos uma empresa Francesa e líder mundial em equipamentos domésticos de pequeno porte. Presente em 150 países com quase 30 marcas no nosso portfólio global, atualmente o grupo possui 492 patentes de produtos ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, destacamos principalmente Arno e Rochedo.

Com 41 unidades industriais, incluindo 2 no Brasil e 11 na França, temos 350 milhões de produtos vendidos por ano sendo 12 produtos vendidos no mundo a cada segundo.

Sua missão:

A posição de Estagiário de Remuneração, Budget, Mobilidade Global e People Analytics desempenha um papel multifacetado na área de Recursos Humanos de uma organização, fornecendo suporte vital para atividades relacionadas à gestão dessas áreas . Este papel é crucial para garantir a equidade salarial, o controle de despesas, o planejamento financeiro e a facilitação de processos de mobilidade global da empresa, além de transformar dados em informações relevantes para tomada de decisão.

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Suporte na Análise de Remuneração: Auxiliar na coleta e análise de dados relacionados à remuneração dos colaboradores, incluindo aqueles em mobilidade global. Isso envolve a revisão de informações sobre salários, benefícios e políticas de expatriação, garantindo a equidade salarial e a conformidade com regulamentos locais e internacionais.
  • Participação em Pesquisas Salariais: Contribuir para a realização de pesquisas salariais, incluindo aquelas específicas para colaboradores em mobilidade global. Analisar tendências do mercado e fazer recomendações sobre ajustes na estrutura de remuneração.
  • Assistência na Elaboração do Orçamento de Pessoal: Apoiar a equipe na preparação e manutenção do orçamento de pessoal da empresa.
  • Colaboração no Processo de Planejamento Financeiro: Auxiliar na elaboração de relatórios e análises financeiras relacionadas aos custos de pessoal, incluindo aqueles relacionados à mobilidade global.
  • Gestão da Mobilidade Global: Prestar suporte administrativo e operacional para processos de mobilidade global, incluindo a coordenação de vistos, autorizações de trabalho, realocação, alojamento e benefícios para expatriados.
  • Manutenção de Dados e Documentação: Garantir a precisão e a integridade dos dados relacionados à remuneração, orçamento e mobilidade global, mantendo registros atualizados e precisos. Isso inclui a criação e manutenção de documentação relevante, como políticas de remuneração, procedimentos de orçamento e diretrizes de mobilidade.
  • Suporte Administrativo Geral: Prestar assistência administrativa geral à equipe de Recursos Humanos, conforme necessário, ajudando em tarefas como organização de arquivos, agendamento de reuniões e comunicação com colaboradores.

O que você precisa ter para fazer parte desse time:

  • Cursando a partir do 2º ano de graduação, Administração de empresas, Engenharias Estatística, Matemática, Economia e áreas afins.
  • Estudar no período noturno, com disponibilidade para estagiar 6 horas/dia;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office Avançado.
  • Inglês Intermediário;
  • Formação prevista a partir de 06/2027.

title: IT Applications and Analytics Analyst LATAM
description:
Company Description

Red Bull gives wings to all people, to fly in whichever direction they want, respecting and tolerating the trajectory of each one, regardless of gender expression, race, religion, affective-sexual orientation, origin, age or disability. In the world of Red Bull, everyone is welcome.

The IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM acts upon the global IT strategy, is responsible for the IT relevant coordination and communication of global business applications, their deployments within the area and head-coach regions, supporting demand process and service ownership for regional and local business applications.

Job Description

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

· The IT Application & Analytics LATAM works thoroughly aligned with HQs BA service owners, HQ Data Team, BRMs and local peers of IT and business to ensure staying informed about relevant projects for counterparts in countries.

· The IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM is responsible for service ownership and management of specific LATAM Analytics products.

· The IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM is also responsible for assessing insights related demands from the different areas of the business (sales , logistics, marketing, etc), scoping the need and identifying the right technology together with it’s counterparts in LATAM or HQ. For the realization of analytics demands, the IT Application & Analytics analyst LATAM either relies on the skillset of other peers in the organization or will directly integrate and visualize data.

DEMAND CAPTURE & ALIGNMENT PROCESS SUPPORT

· Person acts as regional counterpart for Analytics requests.

· Capturing, scoping, documenting and prioritizing local demands (incl. HQ security or local privacy requirements).

· Thorough understanding of the underlying business case.

· Enabling the business-to-business communication.

· Ensuring a well-prepared and transparent decision process.

· Communication and explanation of taken decisions.

SUPPORTING SERVICE DELIVERY & PROJECTS

· Project oversight for global or regional projects.

· Project documentation and action plans on communication, training, handover, support.

· Stakeholder communication.

· Third Party Management.

· Satisfaction of business and users with new services or the operation throughout.

SUPPORTING SERVICE OWNERSHIP, OPERATION & CSI PROCESSES

· Service ownership for aligned and agreed regional services.

· Management and coordination of external support & development partners.

· Alignment with local and global service owners to ensure strategy fit of solutions.

· Alignment, development and maintenance of service roadmaps within the IT area.

· Ensure country requirements are communicated to global service owners.

· Regular review of operational KPIs to ensure insights on the service knowledge and performance are generated and improvement actions are derived.

ANALYTICS

· Assessing analytics demands from teams across the area LATAM.

· Performing user interviews to understand the different interests of the people involved.

· Analyzing the different data involved and their sources.

· Working with HQ Data committee to define a goal for the data visualization.

· Identifying data integration options, methods and technology.

· Aligning the approach with decision makers in the area LATAM and HQ.

· Support the realization process through externals or realization autonomously depending on the topic and the skill set.

· Closing demands ensuring success.

· Documenting and managing analytics use cases throughout their lifecycle.

Qualifications

Degree in computer science, business informatics or equivalent experience.

Strong communicator and relator, solid and broad business process understanding.

Project Management experience, ITIL knowhow beyond theory.

Team-oriented, self-driven and motivated personality, hands-on and flexible, thinking from the end.

Ability to understand complex and different types of requirements and translate those into technical concepts.

Excellent skills to interact with all levels of employees/executives.

Precise, systematic, accuracy and structured way of working.

Performance and result orientation.

Spoken and written English mandatory, Spanish a plus.

Strong mathematical skills to help collect, measure, organize and analyze data.

Interest or experience on working with analytics skills, such as data management and visualization.

Technical proficiency regarding database design development, data models, techniques for data mining and segmentation.

We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Price and Promotion Consulting and Implementation Manager
description:
dunnhumby is the global leader in Customer Data Science, partnering with the world’s most ambitious retailers and brands to put the customer at the heart of every decision. We combine deep insight, advanced technology, and close collaboration to help our clients grow, innovate, and deliver measurable value for their customers.

dunnhumby employs nearly 2,500 experts in offices throughout Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Americas working for transformative, iconic brands such as Tesco, Coca-Cola, Nestlé, Unilever and Metro.

We are looking for Price and Promotion Consulting and Implementation Manager who can apply technology to promote the success of our retail clients while addressing business requirements through workflow design, configuring software for optimal client results, and conducting training in accordance with best practices. The Price and Promotion consulting and implementation manager will lead the deployment of dunnhumby’s P&P solutions to new and existing clients. They will work closely with the client’s teams to understand their requirements and ensure that our tools are fit for purpose.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of P&P Products: Ensure the timely and successful delivery of price and promotion software solutions that meet client’s needs and objectives, in line with the project plan. Analyse large and complex datasets to identify potential gaps and inconsistencies during the deployment process.
  • Drive Change: Develop and maintain trusted advisor relationships with client teams, guiding them through change by implementing new price and promotional processes. Work closely with the product teams to influence the roadmap based on clients’ feedback and develop new features collaboratively.
  • Process & Requirements Documentation: Understand and document the client’s current processes, identify and organize their business and process requirements, and work with the Price & Promotion Consulting Director and the wider team to recommend best-in-class solutions.
  • Software Configuration & Testing: Configure enterprise price and promotions software to align with specific client processes and needs. Develop and implement internal and external testing processes. Perform testing and analysis of data to ensure accuracy and effectiveness of software solutions.
  • GO Live support: Contribute to the successful execution of the GO Live phase by demonstrating the tool’s added value to the client. This involves organizing and participating in client sessions, conducting category analysis, proposing optimal solutions, and monitoring progress through measurement, reporting, and activity tracking.

Required Experience

  • Extensive experience working at a retailer/ FMCG within the Merchandising space and in enterprise software implementations. Specific expertise in Price and Promotions solutions desirable
  • A college degree or equivalent professional experience required
  • Strong business analysis and data analytics skills. Data visualization, advanced Microsoft Excel, programming language a plus
  • Support pre-sales activities and lead generation in coordination with Sales and Client teams to ensure the proper positioning of our P&P solutions to meet clients’ needs.
  • Experience in project management and workflow optimization

What you can expect from us

We won’t just meet your expectations. We’ll defy them. So you’ll enjoy the comprehensive rewards package you’d expect from a leading technology company. But also, a degree of personal flexibility you might not expect. Plus, thoughtful perks, like flexible working hours and your birthday off.

You’ll also benefit from an investment in cutting-edge technology that reflects our global ambition. But with a nimble, small-business feel that gives you the freedom to play, experiment and learn.

And we don’t just talk about diversity and inclusion. We live it every day – with thriving networks including dh Gender Equality Network, dh Proud, dh Family, dh One, dh Enabled and dh Thrive as the living proof. We want everyone to have the opportunity to shine and perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. Please let us know how we can make this process work best for you.

Our approach to Flexible Working

At dunnhumby, we value and respect difference and are committed to building an inclusive culture by creating an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work.

We believe that you will do your best at work if you have a work / life balance. Some roles lend themselves to flexible options more than others, so if this is important to you please raise this with your recruiter, as we are open to discussing agile working opportunities during the hiring process.

title: Facilities Manager
description:
MISSION

Lead and oversee all Facilities operations across Corporate Offices, R&D Labs, Manufacturing Plant, and Distribution Center, ensuring safe, efficient, compliant, and cost-effective infrastructure. Drive operational excellence through strong vendor management, robust maintenance programs, and continuous improvement. Act as the key connection between local operations and global standards for EHS, Engineering, and Sustainability.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensure a safe work environment by promoting a strong safety culture and full compliance with legal requirements, NRs, company HSE policies, and global corporate standards.
  • Guarantee the integrity, reliability, and availability of all facilities infrastructure, including utilities, HVAC, electrical systems, water treatment, fire protection, building automation, and critical assets.
  • Lead, develop, and oversee internal and outsourced teams (maintenance, cleaning, security, reception, gardening, cafeteria, and services).
  • Manage preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance programs, ensuring uptime and operational continuity for Office, R&D Labs, Manufacturing, and Distribution Center.
  • Oversee facilities services to ensure high service levels, cost efficiency, and adherence to SLAs.
  • Lead improvement initiatives to enhance energy efficiency, sustainability, waste reduction, and operational performance.
  • Ensure compliance with certifications, internal audits, external audits, and global standards (ISO, GMP where applicable).
  • Oversee space planning, workplace strategy, building layout updates, and occupancy optimization.
  • Manage construction projects, renovations, expansions, and infrastructure modifications from planning to delivery, ensuring alignment with Capex governance.
  • Coordinate incident management, emergency response plans, fire brigade activities, and building security protocols.
  • Monitor and manage facilities KPIs, identifying root causes and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage Opex and Capex budgets, ensuring cost optimization and adherence to financial targets.
  • Collaborate with key internal stakeholders (Manufacturing, R&D, Supply Chain, HR, IT, Security, Finance) to ensure seamless and compliant operations.
  • Ensure vendor management excellence, including contract negotiation, performance monitoring, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for facilities matters with local leadership and global functional teams.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), Architecture, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Experience managing Facilities operations across multi-site or complex environments (Office, Industrial, Logistics, or R&D).
  • Minimum of 5 years of proven leadership experience in maintenance, utilities, infrastructure, or facilities services.
  • Strong technical background in building systems (HVAC, electrical, utilities, fire systems).
  • Demonstrated experience in maintenance management, vendor management, and project leadership.
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian regulatory requirements (NRs), engineering standards, and EHS.
  • Proven experience in managing Capex and Opex budgets.
  • Experience in multinational environments is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

SOFT SKILLS

  • Ownership mindset, with strong presence in operations and a hands-on approach.
  • High level of discipline, organization, and operational rigor.
  • Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning mindset.
  • Agile, creative, and solution-oriented profile.
  • Strong critical thinking and ability to anticipate risks.
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams with engagement and accountability.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Resilience and ability to deliver impactful results under pressure.

title: Service Delivery Manager - Enterprise Support (Remote)
description:
About the company

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.

Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.

About the role

We’re looking for an experienced Service Delivery Manager to take ownership of our service operations:

  • SLAs and incident processes
  • on‑call and skills coverage
  • SOPs and first‑line/SRE enablement
  • configuration management
  • SLA metrics and reporting
  • and coordination between customers and our engineering teams.

This is a hands‑on role , not a pure governance role. You will be close to real incidents, engineers, and customers and you’ll be expected to bring in practices you’ve already used successfully in previous service or managed‑services environments.

What you’ll do1. Service operations, on‑call & incidents
  • Design and maintain an on‑call and coverage plan that ensures all critical skills are available when needed (initially weekdays, evolving to full 24/7 where required).
  • Own the incident management process for your accounts: priorities, roles, communication cadence, escalations, and post‑incident reviews.
  • Define and monitor key service metrics (e.g., MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, backlog health) and drive improvements based on them.
  • Act as incident lead / coordinator during major incidents, keeping engineers focused and customers informed.
2. SOPs, runbooks & first‑line enablement
  • Create and maintain SOPs, runbooks, and triage guides for SRE engineers, covering common incident types and operational tasks.
  • Train and coach first‑line/SRE teams so they can confidently handle initial triage, basic troubleshooting, and clear communication , escalating only when needed.
  • Continuously refine documentation based on real incident experience and feedback.
3. Configuration management & readiness
  • Establish and run a configuration management process that keeps track of each customer’s environment (platforms in use, clusters, regions, configs, access, monitoring, key contacts).
  • Proactively close information gaps by working directly with customers and engineers.
  • Ensure configuration information is available and trustworthy during incidents and for onboarding new engineers.
4. Customer communication & governance
  • Be the primary operational contact for a set of enterprise customers.
  • Lead regular service reviews and status calls , presenting SLA performance, key incidents, risks, and improvement actions.
  • Present and agree on the incident management process with customers (channels, priorities, escalation paths, expectations).
  • Work closely with Account Management / Sales on renewals, expansions, and expectation management.
5. Commercial & delivery management
  • Clarify what is in scope vs. out of scope and work with customers and Sales to shape paid change requests when additional work is needed.
  • Monitor effort vs. contract , help protect margins, and flag risks early (under‑scoped contracts, chronic over‑use, under‑utilized capacity).
  • Work in a matrix environment , coordinating with different technical teams (e.g., database engineering, DevOps, SRE) to staff and deliver engagements effectively.
6. Onboarding & training
  • Design and maintain onboarding paths for new engineers joining support/delivery (shadowing, training on SOPs, environment overviews, “certification” on certain incident types).
  • Ensure new team members reach a productive, independent state quickly and safely.
What success looks like in 6–12 months
  • On‑call coverage is clear, predictable, and sustainable ; engineers know when they’re on and what’s expected.
  • First‑line/SREs handle a meaningful share of incidents without escalation , using well‑maintained runbooks.
  • You can open a customer’s configuration, see an accurate picture, and use it during incidents and planning.
  • SLA and incident metrics are tracked, reported, and discussed regularly with customers and internally.
  • Customers have a clear understanding of how incidents are handled and feel confident in the process.
  • New engineers ramp up faster thanks to structured onboarding and training.
You’ll be a great fit if you have
  • 5+ years in a Service Delivery, Managed Services, IT Operations, or Enterprise Support role serving external customers (not only internal IT).
  • Experience with 24/7 or extended‑hours operations , including on‑call or follow‑the‑sun setups.
  • Hands‑on experience with incident management and ITSM practices (incident/problem/change), ideally in an ITIL‑inspired environment.
  • A track record of creating or improving SOPs/runbooks and training first‑line / SRE teams.
  • Experience maintaining configuration / environment data for customer systems.
  • Comfort discussing technical topics with engineers (cloud, distributed systems, data platforms) and explaining them in clear business terms to customers.
  • Experience in commercial delivery : scope boundaries, change requests, effort vs. revenue, working alongside Sales / Account Management.
  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

Nice to have

  • Background with data, analytics, or streaming platforms (e.g., Druid, Kafka, Flink, StarRocks, ClickHouse, TiDB, Hadoop, cloud data warehouses).
  • Experience working in small, fast‑moving, remote teams.
Location & working style
  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.
  • We are flexible on contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.

title: Business Analyst
description:
THE ROLE

Love building things fast and figuring out what works? Curious about AI and excited to push the boundaries of what's possible? We're looking for a Business Analyst to join our Strategy team. You'll be our rapid prototyper---turning ideas into working features, testing what resonates, and handing off polished concepts to engineering for the full build. It's part builder, part thinker, and a whole lot of experimentation.

You'll work directly with the VP of Strategy and collaborate across product, engineering, and AI teams to bring new features to life quickly. If you're resourceful, creative, and love the thrill of "let's just try it and see," you'll thrive here.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Build fully functioning feature prototypes using AI tools like Claude Code and our platform
  • Test, iterate, and refine ideas with real users before they hit full production
  • Work backwards from customer problems to design solutions that actually solve them
  • Collaborate with engineers to hand off working prototypes for implementation
  • Stay curious about AI capabilities and explore creative ways to leverage them

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • A knack for figuring things out---you don't need to know code, but you're not afraid to tinker
  • Strong product intuition and a bias toward action over perfection
  • Experience building, prototyping, or problem-solving in scrappy environments
  • Excellent communication skills---you can explain what you built and why it matters
  • Genuine interest in AI and emerging tools (exposure is a plus, enthusiasm is a must)
  • Bonus points for finance experience, but not required
  • Bonus points if you've worked with automation tools, no-code platforms, or AI assistants

Why Street Diligence?

We're The Deal Nerds making sense of complex contracts so our clients don't have to. But we're also builders who believe the best way to know if something works is to build it and test it. We move fast, we experiment often, and we're not afraid to try the unconventional approach. If you love the zero-to-one phase and want to shape how AI transforms financial intelligence, come join the crew.

title: Cientista de Dados Pleno
description:
A Privacy é a maior rede social de conteúdo digital da América Latina. Nascemos para conectar tecnologia ao poder criativo das pessoas. Somos um organismo vivo, onde cada pessoa é uma célula pulsante de abundância, liberdade e autorrealização.

  • Desenvolver, validar e manter modelos de Machine Learning (regressão, classificação, clustering e séries temporais);
  • Executar análises estatísticas e testes de hipótese (ex: A/B Testing) para validar insights e estratégias;
  • Construir visualizações e relatórios claros e eficazes para comunicação de resultados;
  • Atuar em parceria com times de produto, engenharia e negócios , traduzindo achados técnicos em ações práticas;
  • Participar ativamente da construção de uma cultura orientada a dados , contribuindo com boas práticas e padronizações;
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos modelos em produção , garantindo melhoria contínua e rastreabilidade.

O que valorizamos

Raciocínio analítico e curiosidade intelectual: pessoas que questionam, testam hipóteses e buscam compreender profundamente o problema antes de propor soluções.

Foco em impacto: profissionais que entendem o “porquê” por trás dos modelos e direcionam seus esforços para gerar valor real para o negócio.

Autonomia e colaboração: capacidade de conduzir projetos de ponta a ponta, em parceria com engenheiros de dados e áreas de produto.

Comunicação clara: traduzir resultados técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos de forma acessível e objetiva.

Inovação contínua: curiosidade para aprender novas ferramentas e aplicar novas técnicas de ciência de dados e IA.

Requisitos

  • Domínio de Python e suas principais bibliotecas de Data Science (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn);
  • Experiência sólida com SQL para extração, manipulação e análise de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Conhecimento prático em Machine Learning aplicado (regressão, classificação, clustering, séries temporais);
  • Base sólida em estatística e testes de hipóteses ;
  • Habilidade em visualização de dados (Matplotlib, Seaborn, Power BI ou equivalentes);
  • Familiaridade com o ciclo de vida completo de projetos de Data Science (da coleta ao monitoramento de modelos);
  • Boas práticas de código e programação orientada a objetos (POO) ;
  • Experiência em ambientes colaborativos e com versionamento de código (Git, GitHub, GitLab).

Diferenciais

  • Vivência com ferramentas de Big Data (Spark, Databricks);
  • Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure);
  • Conhecimento em MLOps (deploy de modelos, Docker, CI/CD);
  • Experiência em Deep Learning (TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch);
  • Participação em projetos de Sistemas de Recomendação (filtragem colaborativa, embeddings, modelos híbridos);
  • Familiaridade com bancos de dados vetoriais (Pinecone, ChromaDB) e arquiteturas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) .

  • Hibrido — escritório na Zona Sul – São Paulo/SP
  • Ambiente colaborativo, com cultura forte , liberdade técnica e foco em inovação
  • Estrutura horizontal, com autonomia para propor, testar e evoluir soluções

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde (disponível para CNPJs com mais de 6 meses) ;
  • TotalPass – academias, estúdios e atividades de bem-estar;
  • Alura – acesso à plataforma de aprendizado contínuo;
  • Espaço para crescimento e protagonismo , com aprendizado constante e impacto direto na estrutura financeira da empresa.

Por que entrar na Privacy

Estamos construindo uma área de dados moderna, escalável e com papel estratégico no crescimento da Privacy.

Aqui, você terá autonomia para testar hipóteses, desenvolver modelos preditivos e contribuir diretamente para decisões que impactam milhões de pessoas.

Se você é movido por desafios, inovação e quer fazer parte de uma empresa que une tecnologia, propósito e impacto real , essa é a sua oportunidade.

title: Director of Salesforce Implementation
description:

The Director of Salesforce Implementation will lead a team of up to 15 Salesforce professionals across the US and LATAM, including consultants, developers, administrators, solution architects, and marketing automation specialists (MCAE and MCE). This role is responsible for project delivery excellence, ensuring projects are scoped accurately, executed effectively, delivered on time, and aligned with client expectations and IMG quality standards. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce expertise with proven team leadership, project governance, delivery operations, and client relationship skills. This director will serve as the operational leader of the implementation team, optimizing processes, reviewing time and utilization, providing coaching, managing escalations, and driving exceptional customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership and Management

  • Lead and mentor a cross-functional Salesforce implementation team across US and LATAM.
  • Provide coaching, one-on-ones, growth planning, and performance management.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and high-quality delivery.
  • Manage staffing, capacity planning, and resource allocation across all active projects.

Project and Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee all Salesforce implementation projects including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (MCAE), Marketing Cloud Engagement (MCE), and integrations.
  • Conduct regular project reviews to ensure progress, scope alignment, and adherence to timelines.
  • Monitor time tracking, utilization, and project budgets; identify trends and address over-burn or under-delivery risks.
  • Establish and refine delivery processes, best practices, and standard operating procedures.

Quality Control and Customer Satisfaction

  • Ensure projects meet IMG quality standards and deliver measurable business value.
  • Provide strategic oversight and intervention on escalations or complex project challenges.
  • Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive communication and alignment.
  • Partner with the Sales team during handoff to ensure a smooth transition from scoping to delivery.

Operational Excellence

  • Develop and maintain predictable implementation workflows and project governance frameworks.
  • Improve reporting and tracking across project health, timelines, scope changes, and team utilization.
  • Implement delivery tools, templates, documentation standards, and internal QA processes.
  • Collaborate with leadership on forecasting, hiring needs, and Salesforce practice growth.

Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams to ensure alignment across the client lifecycle.
  • Participate in internal strategic planning, service-offering refinement, and productization of Salesforce packages such as Jumpstart.
  • Support revenue growth by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities during implementation.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7 or more years of Salesforce implementation experience (consulting or client-side).
  • 3 or more years leading technical or consulting teams, preferably remote or geographically distributed.
  • Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and marketing automation platforms (MCAE and MCE).
  • Proven ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects and large-scale client engagements.
  • Experience with resource planning, time tracking, utilization reporting, and delivery KPIs.
  • Strong communication, leadership, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Ability to operate at both the strategic and tactical levels.

Preferred

  • Salesforce certifications.
  • Experience at a Salesforce partner agency or professional services organization.
  • Background with project management tools such as Asana, Monday, or Wrike.
  • Experience with US, LATAM, and offshore team management.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance bonus structure.
  • Flexible remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to lead a rapidly expanding Salesforce practice.
  • Supportive leadership and a culture focused on growth, innovation, and client success.
  • Professional development opportunities and Salesforce certification support.
  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and emphasis on work-life balance.

title: 3D Designer - Cinema 4D Specialist (Product, Commercial)
description:
Contractor/Freelance Position | 100% Remote (Full-Time)

We are specifically looking to review portfolios from individuals based in Brazil and Argentina .

About the role

We are seeking a talented Cinema 4D Designer to join our Creative team, specializing in high-fidelity, marketing-grade 3D rendering, imagery, and product animation. This role is responsible for generating stunning, hyper-realistic 3D visuals, clean motion assets, and sophisticated compositing work (photomontages) across our diverse portfolio of brands. This position requires exceptional skill in achieving professional authenticity and meticulous attention to detail. You will collaborate closely with Graphic Designers and other team members to translate creative concepts into precise, high-quality visuals, ensuring consistent and professional execution for all our business-focused content.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop high-end, hyper-realistic product and lifestyle scenes, including advanced image compositing (photomontages), from various reference materials.
  • Create professional 3D product animations (e.g., product rotations, camera moves, and simple showcases).
  • Help us set new standards for the modeling, texturing, lighting of our products, with an absolute dedication to visual authenticity.
  • Accurately translate design concepts into detailed 3D models.
  • Develop high-resolution final images and video assets of rendered content.
  • Successfully balance and prioritise multiple projects simultaneously to meet deadlines.
  • Work with varied project briefs, cooperate with Graphic Designers, and support the wider Creative team.
  • Ensure adherence to brand guidelines, adapting to the distinct visual approaches required for our various brands.
  • Uphold design standards, including consistent file-naming structures and meticulous folder organisation.

Requirements

  • Mandatory: Expert proficiency in Cinema 4D. Please note that this is a strict requirement; we are not seeking users of Blender, 3ds Max, or Maya for this role. Experience with Octane Render is highly preferred.
  • You possess a strong portfolio that showcases expertise in high-definition, commercial-style 3D visualizations, expert image compositing, and 3D animation. Portfolios focused only on character design, game assets, or abstract/fantasy scenes are not suitable for this role.
  • Mandatory: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills are required. You must be able to fluently communicate and clearly articulate technical 3D constraints to non-technical team members.
  • You have 4+ years’ experience as a 3D designer. Ideally, you’ll have worked in a graphic/animation studio, advertising agency, or an in-house creative department and have some experience working with beauty or wellness products.
  • You possess a proactive interest in emerging 3D technologies and have a willingness to explore AI-powered tools to optimize workflows and push creative boundaries.
  • You are capable of assessing a brief and determining the most effective execution strategy - knowing when to push for technical excellence and when to utilise smart shortcuts to meet tight turnarounds.
  • You are educated to degree level in Design or a related subject (e.g., Graphic Design, Product Design, Animation, or Motion Design).
  • You are proficient in modeling and texturing, and can create stunning, life-like visual assets of packaging, single products, and detailed marketing scenes. Your output must demonstrate strict adherence to photographic quality and detail.
  • You have expertise in lighting set-up, colour, and shading, with a keen focus on optimal product presentation to achieve visual authenticity.
  • You have a superb sense of composition, visual veracity (truthfulness), texture, and illumination, and a sophisticated understanding of materials. You can view products from a customer's perspective.
  • You are highly skilled with Adobe Photoshop (essential for compositing/photomontages) and knowledgeable about the broader Adobe Creative Suite.
  • You can effectively plan, prioritise, and problem-solve in a fast-paced environment, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

To apply:

Please submit your CV and portfolio. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Sales Operations Analyst
description:

title: Global Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as University of São Paulo, UNICAMP and UNESP. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role

We are seeking a proactive, results-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our global HR team. In this role, you will drive the hiring of top-tier talent across Europe and APAC, and help us build high-performing teams in both technical and business functions. You will own the end-to-end recruitment process, build and nurture strong talent pipelines, and deliver a fast, high-quality hiring experience that directly contributes to our company’s growth and success worldwide.

  • Ability to adapt quickly, work independently, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ambitious, results-driven, and thrives in high-growth settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, and candidate experience skills.

Why Join JoVE?

  • You can expect compensation package competitively placed within the local market
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team

We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.

Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.

Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.

Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.g., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.

Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role; experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.g., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
Korn Ferry, on behalf of John Deere, a U.S. multinational company and leader in the agricultural and construction machinery industry, is seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer for a position based in Indaiatuba, SP.

About John Deere & the Role

John Deere is a global technology company providing software and equipment for agriculture, construction, and forestry. With a strong presence in Brazil and Latin America for over 30 years, the company operates key manufacturing sites in São Paulo, Goiás, and Rio Grande do Sul.

For 2025, John Deere is accelerating its focus on autonomous solutions, AI, and connectivity. To support this expansion, John Deere is building a new team in Brazil to develop and scale applications that enhance digital products and services.

As a Senior Software Engineer – Full-Stack (Front-End Heavy), you will primarily contribute to the design and development of modern front-end applications using React, while occasionally working on backend services. You will also have opportunities to work with emerging technologies, including Machine Learning (ML) and Generative AI (GenAI), to enhance customer-facing applications.

You will leverage technologies like React, APIs, cloud platforms, and AI/GenAI tools to create intuitive, scalable, and secure applications that improve the customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development – Build scalable, high-performance front-end applications using React.
  • UI/UX Collaboration – Work closely with designers and product teams to deliver intuitive, customer-centric interfaces.
  • Backend Integration – Contribute to backend development when needed, with a focus on Python or Java (differential).
  • API Development & Integration – Connect front-end solutions with APIs and ensure smooth data flow across platforms.
  • Cloud & DevOps Enablement – Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and deployment.
  • Technology Exploration – Evaluate and adopt emerging tools, including ML/GenAI, to drive innovation and improve productivity.
  • Quality & Security by Design – Apply best practices in coding, testing, and security to ensure robust and reliable solutions.

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Deliver modern, React-based user interfaces that integrate seamlessly with backend systems.
  • Ensure front-end solutions are scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
  • Adapt quickly to new technologies and contribute across the stack when necessary.
  • Support the adoption of AI and GenAI to enhance customer-facing applications.
  • Maintain alignment with John Deere’s vision for autonomous operations, AI, and digital optimization.

Experience & Qualifications

  • Must-have: Extensive hands-on experience with React and front-end frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with backend services.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, containers, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with a focus on user experience.
  • Collaborative mindset, willing to contribute to both front-end and backend tasks.
  • Differential: Experience with Python or Java for backend development.
  • Differential: Experience in Machine Learning (ML) or Generative AI (GenAI) projects.
  • Differential: Exposure to multi-cloud environments or full-stack design patterns.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • Advanced/Fluent English to collaborate in an international environment.

Location: Indaiatuba, SP

Model: Hybrid – 3x per week at the office

title: Analista de Crédito e Cobrança Sênior
description:
Escopo

É responsável por analisar, estruturar e interpretar dados relacionados à carteira de crédito e cobrança, fornecendo insights estratégicos que apoiem a gestão da área. Atua de forma integrada com clientes, áreas internas, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos de inadimplência, a recuperação de saldos em aberto e a melhoria contínua dos processos e políticas de crédito.

Principais Atribuições

  • Realizar análises de crédito e definição de limites, identificando riscos de inadimplência (default) e oportunidades de negócio;
  • Estruturar e acompanhar indicadores-chave (KPIs) de crédito e cobrança, elaborando relatórios e dashboards que apoiem a tomada de decisão da liderança;
  • Conduzir análises financeiras e preditivas, com base em dados internos e externos, para identificar tendências de risco, oportunidades de renegociação e estratégias de recuperação;
  • Apoiar a recuperação de saldos inadimplentes, através de negociações diretas e propostas baseadas em inteligência de dados;
  • Atuar na revisão e melhoria contínua de processos, políticas e fluxos de crédito e cobrança, garantindo alinhamento às diretrizes corporativas e aos controles internos;
  • Controlar e monitorar a inclusão e exclusão de títulos em órgãos de proteção ao crédito;
  • Garantir a acuracidade e integridade das informações enviadas para áreas internas (Comercial, Financeiro, Controladoria, Auditoria, etc.);
  • Apoiar o processo de fechamento contábil, validando saldos e assegurando a conformidade com os prazos e normas internas;
  • Ser o ponto de referência para a equipe, compartilhando conhecimento, realizando treinamentos e contribuindo em projetos de melhoria;
  • Elaborar estudos sobre a carteira de clientes, segmentação de risco e modelos analíticos de previsão de inadimplência.

Requisitos

  • Formação completa em Administração de Empresas, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Habilidade uso ERP SAP S/4 Hana
  • Excel avançado;
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Power BI;
  • Inglês e Espanhol serão considerados diferenciais;
  • Análise de demonstrações financeiras, com cálculo de indicadores de liquidez, endividamento e rentabilidade, essenciais para avaliar a saúde financeira do cliente.

  • Conhecimento em Arquitetura Frontend (React) e Mobile (Flutter)

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o desenho e a integração das arquiteturas de sistemas para suportar operações de front, middle e backoffice, bem como integrações com a B3 e outros participantes do mercado financeiro
  • Atuar na definição de padrões, políticas, escolha de tecnologias e ferramentas para garantir robustez e modernidade das soluções (on-premises, cloud e híbridas)
  • Apoiar áreas de negócios e times de desenvolvimento na identificação de demandas, traduzindo requisitos em soluções tecnológicas aderentes ao negócio da corretora
  • Avaliar continuamente a aderência dos sistemas à regulação vigente (CVM, B3, Banco Central), normas de segurança (ISO 27001, LGPD, PCI)
  • Conduzir revisões de arquitetura, análise de risco, testes de performance e capacity planning
  • Estabelecer diretrizes para integração segura com parceiros, fornecedores e plataformas externas
  • Fomentar a cultura DevSecOps, promovendo automação, governança e práticas de desenvolvimento seguro
  • Apoiar projetos de inovação tecnológica e transformação digital na corretora
  • Produzir documentação clara e atualizada sobre topologia de sistemas, interfaces, fluxos operacionais e padrões arquiteturais

O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência sólida em programas de transformação digital ou tecnológica.
  • Atuação com áreas técnicas e não técnicas (engenharia, segurança, arquitetura, negócio, executivos).
  • Experiência em agilidade de times e escala (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento prático de:
  • Team Design baseado em Spotify
  • Team Topologies (Stream-aligned, Platform, Enablement, Complicated Subsystem)
  • Vivência com práticas DevSecOps.
  • Experiência com Lean Portfolio Management e OKRs.
  • Integração prática entre ferramentas do ciclo de desenvolvimento: Jira, GitHub

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.g., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.g., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

title: Risk Analyst
description:
About Credix  

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job 

In SME credit, advantage compounds through disciplined underwriting, fast learning cycles, and early detection of risks. As our Credit Analyst, you will strengthen our underwriting edge by translating financial data, behavioural signals, and real-world borrower performance into precise credit decisions- while continuously feeding insights back into our core decision models.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct holistic credit analysis for SMEs: financials, cash-flows, tax compliance, bank data, concentration risks, behavioural signals.
  • Produce concise, decision-ready credit memos with recommendations (approve / adjust / decline).
  • Lead periodic reviews of high-exposure borrowers - liquidity evolution, leverage shifts, payment patterns, and macro impacts.
  • Evaluate and recommend credit-limit increases based on performance, updated financials, and risk appetite.
  • Maintain a closed-loop feedback mechanism between underwriting decisions and portfolio outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Data to translate recurring insights into better thresholds, features, and model logic.
  • Support portfolio monitoring with early-warning detection and risk-mitigation recommendations.
  • Ensure underwriting discipline and audit-ready documentation.

Qualifications

  • 2–3 years in IB, credit, structured credit, asset management, DCM or fintech underwriting.
  • Strong financial analysis: liquidity, leverage, coverage, working-capital dynamics, seasonality.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian tax reporting, accounting regimes, and corporate structures.
  • Experience writing clear, investor-grade credit memos.
  • Understanding of credit models (inputs, outputs, sensitivity) and ability to evaluate their strengths/weaknesses.
  • Bonus: exposure to securitisation, structured credit, data-driven underwriting.
  • High analytical rigor and precision in judgment.
  • “Manager of one”- delivers independently with consistency.
  • Strong verbal and written communication, both in English and Portuguese.
  • Proactive in identifying trends, risks, and model improvement opportunities.
  • Thrives in a high-velocity, high-accountability environment.
  • Passion for modernising Brazil’s B2B credit market through technology and transparency.
  • Integrity, long-term thinking, and intellectual honesty.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Itaim Bibi, Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

  • A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies
  • Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.
  • Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.
  • Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate
  • Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Gerente de Controladoria (Custos)
description:
Nós somos a EssilorLuxottica, líder global no design, fabricação e distribuição de lentes oftálmicas, armações e óculos de sol. A empresa reúne a expertise complementar de dois pioneiros da indústria, um em tecnologias avançadas de lentes e outro na arte da fabricação de óculos icônicos, criando um negócio verticalmente integrado, única e exclusivamente posicionado para atender às necessidades de visão em constante evolução do mundo e à demanda global de uma indústria de óculos em crescimento. Com mais de 180.000 colaboradores em 150 países impulsionando nossas marcas icônicas, nossas pessoas são criativas, empreendedoras e reconhecidas por suas perspectivas e individualidades únicas. Comprometidos com a visão, nós capacitamos as pessoas a "verem mais e serem mais" graças aos nossos designs inovadores e tecnologias de lentes, qualidade excepcional e métodos de processamento de ponta. Todos os dias impactamos a vida de milhões de pessoas ao mudar a maneira como elas veem o mundo.

O Gerente é responsável por liderar processos de fechamento e planejamento financeiro, assegurando qualidade das informações e alinhamento estratégico. Atua na gestão de custos, análise orçamentária e suporte à alta liderança, promovendo desenvolvimento da equipe e conduzindo iniciativas de eficiência financeira e melhoria contínua

  • Garante a execução, qualidade e acuracidade do processo de fechamento mensal e reporte gerencial à matriz, garantindo prazos e qualidade das informações; liderar análises de variações orçamentárias e propor ações estratégicas para otimização de resultados
  • Responsável pelo roll-out das estratégias de governanças de custos vindas da matriz Global e Regional, em linha com as práticas contábeis locais e seguindo as políticas de MCS da empresa
  • Garante a elaboração de forecasts mensais e Budget anual, assegurando consistência e alinhamento estratégico, além disso é responsável por criar todo story-telling e dinâmica de apresentação dos orçamentos e resultados de Quarter e mensais à Matriz
  • Responsável pela aprovação de ordens de compra de OPEX e CAPEX, garantindo compliance e gestão orçamentária da fábrica dentro de um spend anual de 70m EUR
  • Desenha e aplica as estratégias de desenvolvimento do time, incluindo planos de carreira e sucessão, promove o engajamento e motivação do time bem como a evolução técnica e cultura de alta performance
  • Assegurar conformidade com normas contábeis e políticas corporativas, incluindo suporte a auditorias internas e externas
  • Conduzir projetos estratégicos de melhoria contínua e iniciativas de eficiência financeira, acompanhando CAPEX junto ao time de projetos e engenharia

REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS

Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas

Experiencia em Controladoria, incluindo experiência em liderança de equipe

Excel avançado

SAP (mandatório)

Planejamento financeiro e análise de custos

Inglês avançado (conversação e escrita)

Gestão de pessoas e liderança

title: Supervisor(a) de Base
description:
A Brunel está em busca de um(a) Supervisor(a) de Base para atuar em um contrato temporário de 3 meses (com possibilidade de extensão) , junto a um de nossos clientes do setor de petróleo e gás! Essa posição irá atuar de forma onshore, em uma escala de 14x14, no Porto do Açu (RJ) .

Atividades:

  • Garantia da segurança e conformidade operacional: assegurar o cumprimento dos procedimentos operacionais e de HSE, realizar análises de risco (TRA), PTW, TBT, Lift Plans, reportar incidentes, quase acidentes e promover a cultura de segurança.
  • Liderança e supervisão das operações: liderar equipes nas atividades de manuseio e preparação de cargas e equipamentos, supervisionar atracações/desatracações (port calls), operações de içamento, montagem de acessórios, abertura de containers e inspeções pré-operacionais.

  • Coordenação e interface operacional: atuar como ponto focal com engenheiros, coordenadores e subcontratados, assegurando alinhamento das partes críticas das operações e continuidade segura dos trabalhos.
  • Organização, melhoria contínua e apoio à equipe: aplicar a metodologia 5S, liderar reuniões de segurança, apoiar a execução operacional quando necessário e realizar passagem de turno de forma estruturada.

Requisitos:

  • Formação Técnica ou Auxiliar Técnico com formação do SENAI ou similar em Soldagem, Mecânica, Elétrica, Pneumática e Hidráulica.
  • Experiência com manuseio de cargas e atividades relacionadas a indústria de construção ou naval executando manobras com empilhadeiras, guindastes e outros equipamentos de manuseio ou auxílio para preparação de cargas.

  • Desejável experiência com liderança de equipes.

  • Uso avançado de migrations, mapeamento de entidades e relações complexas.

  • Uso de ferramentas de profiling e análise de logs.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (QA Team)
description:
⚙️ Senior Platform / DevOps Engineer (Enterprise Enablement and QA)

About StackGuardian

At StackGuardian , we’re building the future of secure, compliant, and developer-first cloud orchestration . Our platform enables enterprises to automate infrastructure safely across AWS, Azure, and GCP and bringing together DevOps speed, security guardrails, and platform governance.

We’re looking for a Platform / DevOps Engineer based in Brazil who thrives at the intersection of infrastructure, quality, user experience, and enterprise adoption . This role goes beyond pure DevOps - you’ll help validate features at scale, influence product design, and work directly with beta and platform users.

What You’ll Do

  • Build & Operate the Platform: Design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines using Terraform , CloudFormation , Ansible , GitHub Actions , Docker , and Kubernetes across AWS and Azure.
  • Enterprise-Scale Validation: Work closely with the QA team to test new platform features, workflows, and integrations under realistic enterprise-scale scenarios — performance, security, reliability, and compliance.
  • Enable Product & UX Decisions: Partner with Product and UX teams to provide hands-on technical feedback on new features, workflows, and usability — ensuring designs work in real-world cloud environments.
  • Customer & Beta Engagement: Set up demos, reference architectures, and proof-of-concepts; present solutions to beta users and platform customers , and incorporate feedback into product improvements.
  • Reliability & Observability: Implement monitoring, alerting, and SRE best practices to ensure platform stability, scalability, and operational excellence.

Who We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 4+ years in DevOps, Platform, or SRE roles, preferably supporting enterprise SaaS platforms .
  • IaC Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with Terraform , CloudFormation , and Ansible .
  • CI/CD Mastery: Proven ability to design and maintain pipelines using GitHub Actions , Jenkins , or similar platforms.
  • Cloud Expertise: Solid experience with AWS (EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway) and working knowledge of Azure .
  • Containers & Orchestration: Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Quality & Validation Mindset: Comfort working with QA teams, test environments, and validating features before enterprise rollout.
  • Communication Skills: Ability to explain complex infrastructure concepts clearly to QA, UX, product, and customer-facing teams.
  • Bonus: Experience with security tooling, policy-as-code, compliance workflows, or developer platforms.

Why Join Us

  • You will shape the core architecture of the platform.
  • You’ll have ownership, autonomy, and a real voice in product direction.
  • High-trust culture: direct collaboration with founders, zero needless bureaucracy.
  • Innovation Time: dedicated days for experimentation, architectural research, and prototyping.

Let’s shape the Future of Platform Engineering together!

Main Responsibilities

  • Validar novos produtos e tecnologias: Realizar a análise de viabilidade financeira (TCO - Total Cost of Ownership) para novas ferramentas, serviços de nuvem ou contratações de software antes da aquisição.
  • Análise de Dados e Relatórios: Executar análises detalhadas de billing (faturamento), gerar relatórios de variação orçamentária (Budget vs. Actual) e fornecer insights acionáveis para a liderança.
  • Integração com Arquitetura: Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos de solução para estimar custos de futuros projetos e migrações, garantindo design-to-cost .
  • Garantir Escalabilidade e Qualidade: Assegurar que os modelos de controle financeiro sejam escaláveis para acompanhar o crescimento da nuvem e mantenham padrões de auditoria/compliance rigorosos.
  • Transferência de Conhecimento: Apoiar equipes técnicas com expertise corporativa em finanças, educando engenheiros sobre o impacto financeiro de suas decisões técnicas.

Competências Técnicas:

  • Inglês Fluente (Mandatório): Comunicação verbal e escrita avançada para reportar-se a stakeholders globais.
  • FinOps & Cloud Cost Management: Experiência comprovada em gestão de custos em nuvem (Azure/AWS), incluindo Reserved Instances , Savings Plans e Tagging Strategy .
  • Contabilidade de TI (IT Controlling): Domínio de conceitos de CAPEX vs. OPEX, depreciação de ativos e alocação de custos ( Chargeback/Showback ).
  • SAP ERP: Conhecimento sólido nos módulos financeiros do SAP (FICO, PS - Project Systems) e integração com compras (MM) para rastreio de pedidos de TI.
  • Ferramentas de BI e Excel: Excel Avançado (VBA/Macros é um plus) e Power BI para construção de dashboards financeiros automatizados.
  • Experiência Sênior: Mínimo de 5-8 anos em funções financeiras, com foco específico em Tecnologia da Informação ou Telecom.

Formação:

  • Certificações FinOps: FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP) é um grande diferencial.
  • Conhecimento de Arquitetura Enterprise: Entendimento de como decisões de infraestrutura afetam a estrutura de custos (ex: Serverless vs. VM).
  • Ferramentas de Gestão de Custos: Experiência com ferramentas de mercado como Apptio, CloudHealth ou Azure Cost Management nativo.
  • Métodos Ágeis: Familiaridade com frameworks ágeis (Scrum/SAFe) e como adaptar o planejamento financeiro tradicional para ciclos ágeis (Lean Budgeting).
  • Automação: Noções de Python ou PowerShell para automatizar a coleta de dados de faturas ou integração de APIs de billing.
  • Negociação: Experiência prévia em negociação direta de contratos de software (Enterprise Agreements) com grandes vendors (Microsoft, Oracle, SAP).
